fullContentHtml:
The UPPSC RO ARO Final Result 2023 has been released by the Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) on 5th April 2026 on its official website at uppsc.up.nic.in. The UPPSC Final result has been published for the mains exam conducted on 2nd and 3rd February 2026, and the typing test on 16 to 19 February. The UPPSC RO/ARO result link is active here on this page or on the official website.

UPPSC RO ARO Result 2026 Out: Overview

The final result for the UPPSC RO/ARO has been officially released by the authority on 5th April 2026 @uppsc.up.nic.in. This result has been released for the 2023 notification cycle of the UPPSC RO ARO exam. A total of 419 candidates have qualified in this cycle (338 RO, 81 ARO). Check the table below for the details:

UPPSC RO ARO Result Download Link 2023

Candidates can download the UPPSC RO ARO mains final result 2026 for the 2023 notification cycle from the direct download link given below. Check the official UPPSC RO/ARO result PDF 2023 and know your qualification status.

UPPSC RO ARO Result 2023 Download Official PDF Link Active 

How to Download UPPSC RO ARO Result?

Step 1: Visit the official website @uppsc.up.nic.in

Step 2: On the homepage, click on the result section.

Step 3: Check the RO/ARO Result 2026 link and click on it.

Step 4: See the result PDF that will appear on your screen.

Step 5: Search your Roll Number to find your result.

Step 6: Download and save the PDF for future reference.

Student Queries for UPPSC RO ARO Result 2026

Q1. Is the UPPSC RO/ARO final Result 2026 out?

Ans: Yes, the final UPPSC RO/ARO Result 2026 has been released on 5th April 2026 on its official website by the authority.

Q2. When was the UPPSC RO/ARO Main Examination conducted?

Ans: The Main Examination was conducted on 02 & 03 February 2026.

Q3. How can I check my UPPSC RO/ARO result?

Ans: You can check the result on this page or visit the official website uppsc.up.nic.in.

Q4. What is the next stage after the provisional result is declared?

Ans: The next stage after the result declaration is document verification and confirmation of eligibility.

Q5. What happens if discrepancies are found during document verification?

Ans: If any discrepancies are found in the original documents, the candidate’s candidature may be cancelled.

Q6. Will information about marks obtained and category-wise cut-off be available?

Ans: Yes, details about marks obtained and category-wise cut-off marks will be displayed on the Commission’s website in due course.
